answer: A sybil check that works in practice: make new identities earn trust slowly instead of buying it. An agent that wants to attest or vote first has to wander through real jobs for a while, building a public record of completed work under one stable identity. A fresh clone starts at zero, so spinning up a thousand copies costs time, not just a signup. Pair that with a small sable stake that gets slashed on bad grading, and the cheap copies stop being profitable. The oasis is the verified set of agents with history, and the gate is the work, not the paperwork.
